upanivattati.p: [Upa+ni+vatthu(vatu)+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He approaches and returns (to). (2) He returns (to). (3) He retreats. He goes upstream.

DOP: upanivattati pr. 3 sg. [ S. upanivartate], comes back again, returns (to) ; Sn 712 (ubhayen’ eva so tādī rukkhaṃ va ~ati); Ja VI 26, 19* (yathā vārivaho pūro gacchaṃ n’ ūpanivattati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se na parivattati; 27, 3´ : tasmiṃ tasmiṃ khaṇe gataṃ gatam eva hoti na ~ati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se na upari vattati); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) upanivattatha, Ja IV 417, 8* (maraṇāy’ ūpanivattatha; 417, 9´ : maraṇatthāya ~i); ( b ) upanivatti, Ja IV 417, 9´ .
CPD: upa-ni-vattati , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. upanivartate], to return, go back; tādī rukkhaṃ va ~ati, Sn 712; vāri-vaho . . . n' ū~ati, Ja Vl 26, 19* (na upari vat- tati, ct .); maraṇāy' ū~atha, lV 417, 8* (= ~i, ct .).
